reference_limb_geometry_hash_note: SHA-256 of rounded limb measurements: volume to 0.001 mm3, station circumferences and cutting-plane extent to 0.0001 mm. Negative zero is stored as zero so the hash does not change when a cutting plane lands on z = 0 from either side. STEP text is not hashed, because OpenCascade rewrites entity ids and the FILE_NAME timestamp. The builder does not read this field. Validation recomputes it from the limb STEP.
description: Synthetic open-proximal transtibial socket shell for a computational demonstration. Every default below is a geometry parameter for this demo, not a clinical recommendation, a liner gap, or a pressure model.

coordinate_frame.origin: On the longitudinal axis, in the limb proximal plane

anatomical_orientation.proximal: Toward decreasing Z. The opening plane is z = 0. The rolled brim extends to negative Z.
anatomical_orientation.distal: +Z, the same direction as the referenced limb.
anatomical_orientation.anterior: +Y. This is the demo frame label. The ellipse is symmetric, so the solid does not contain a tibial crest or a patellar-tendon bar.
anatomical_orientation.medial_lateral: X. +X and -X are the two sides of a mirror-symmetric ellipse. This model does not assign medial to a sign, and it does not encode a left or right limb.

morphology.rationale: A smooth shell is the generic socket silhouette: noncircular taper, open rolled brim, closed rounded cup. Patellar-tendon bearing and total-surface bearing are different clinical design families. This model implements neither, and it does not invent relief pockets or trimlines.

construction.note: The wall is one closed curve in the medial-lateral plane: inner cavity, distal inner cap, distal end wall along the axis, outer cap, outer wall, and a semicircular proximal rim. That curve is revolved about Z and then scaled along Y by the limb ap_over_ml. The limb solid is not scaled and is not boolean-cut.

alignment_transform.note: The socket opening plane is the limb proximal plane. A non-identity transform is rejected.

inner_surface_relationship.statement: The inner medial-lateral radius equals the limb medial-lateral radius plus inner_radial_clearance_mm, plus a proximal brim flare, plus any section offset. Anterior-posterior size is that radius times the limb ap_over_ml. This is not a surface-normal offset, not a liner thickness, and not a statement about fit.

proximal_opening_shape.note: The opening is the inner ellipse at z = 0. Its diameters are derived from the limb, the clearance, and the brim flare. ap_over_ml is taken from the limb and is not edited here.

distal_end_geometry.note: The inner and outer caps are quarter ellipses in the medial-lateral plane. The outer tip is socket_depth_mm below the opening plane. The inner tip is distal_wall_thickness_mm short of that tip, so the cup is closed.

rim_geometry.note: In the medial-lateral profile the brim is a semicircle whose diameter is the local wall thickness. Revolution makes a rolled lip. The Y scale turns that circle into an ellipse. There is no sharp proximal edge in the profile.

tolerances.depth_rationale: The outer tip is a point. The last cutting plane sits just short of it. 0.15 mm covers that gap.
tolerances.circumference_rationale: Same 1 mm demonstration limit as the limb. It checks the built ellipse against the elliptic integral of the constructed semi-axes.
tolerances.wall_rationale: Medial-lateral thickness is the difference of section semi-axes. Anterior-posterior thickness is that difference times ap_over_ml, because the solid is scaled once along Y. 0.2 mm is the acceptance band around those constructed values.
tolerances.minimum_wall_note: minimum_wall_thickness_mm is an engineering-demo floor for this file. It is not a structural safety factor.

derived.note: Recomputed from the editable parameters and the limb. Do not edit this block.
